capabilities: Preview external links on hover in a floating, movable, resizable popover
Render live pages in a sandboxed Electron webview that bypasses framing headers
Extract and sanitize article text into a reader view using Mozilla Readability
Show OpenGraph metadata cards with title, description, image and favicon
Embed provider players for media links with automatic popover sizing
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README documents privacy behavior in detail (isolated in-memory cookie storage by default) and known limitations such as OAuth popup sign-in flows, HTTP basic-auth prompts, and mobile falling back to metadata cards.
intentEvidence: Existing hover-preview plugins render pages in an <iframe>.
motivation: Existing hover-preview plugins fail on sites that send X-Frame-Options or CSP frame-ancestors headers (GitHub, Reddit, Wikipedia), so the author built previews on a top-level Electron webview instead.
problem: Core Page Preview covers only internal links, and existing hover-preview plugins render external sites in iframes that most real websites block with framing headers, leaving blank panes.

relations.evidence: extracts the article with Mozilla Readability
media links (YouTube, Vimeo, Dailymotion, Streamable, Loom, Spotify, SoundCloud, Deezer, Apple Music, Apple Podcasts) load the provider's embed player
relations.plugin: YouTube, Vimeo, Dailymotion, Streamable, Loom, Spotify, SoundCloud, Deezer, Apple Music, Apple Podcasts

summary: Floating hover previews for external links: live page via webview, sanitized reader view, or metadata card, with embedded media players.
